title: 🎨 Palette: Improve chat readability and interaction
body:
💡 What:
- Updated the document title from "Create Next App" to "The Union | AI Workspace"
- Added flex wrapping (`min-w-0 flex-1`) and word breaking (`break-words whitespace-pre-wrap`) to chat message UI.
- Swapped the `MessageSquare` icon to a `Send` icon for the chat input submit button.

🎯 Why:
- The default "Create Next App" title provided poor tab discoverability. 
- Long strings of text in user messages were breaking the flex layout and causing horizontal overflow.
- The `MessageSquare` icon for a send button lacked proper affordance; `Send` is universally understood for this action.

📸 Before/After: Screenshot verified via playwright locally.

♿ Accessibility: Ensures that long, unbreakable strings generated by AI or users do not break viewport constraints, improving usability on smaller screens.
